# Benchmark dimensions

| Feature | General heat-kernel estimates | Classical SU(2) formula | Paper 04 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| broad manifolds/groups | yes | no | no |
| exact declared SU(2) convention | varies | yes | yes |
| arbitrary requested finite derivative order | qualitative/implicit | formal differentiation | explicit `Q_m,B_m,G_m` |
| negative-log positivity floor | not usually explicit | no truncation floor | `1-Q0` |
| identity and antipode numerical charts | not application-specific | formula-dependent | explicit paired atlas |
| fraction-valued reproducible certificate | no | no | yes, through order eight |
| optimized constants | sometimes | not applicable | no |
